title: Thai Vegetable Stir Fry
description: A quick and easy stir fry made with a variety of vegetables, perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: vegetables
ingredients.amount: 2 cups (any combination of bell peppers, carrots, broccoli, and onions)

ingredients.name: delight
ingredients.amount: 1 cup (chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces)

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned and cooked through, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the snow peas and cook until tender, about 3-5 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the vegetables.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot and garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
Cook time for chicken is 5-7 minutes.
Cook time for vegetables is 3-5 minutes.
